class="tool-page__section-head"><h2>Frequently Asked Questions</h2></div><div class="tool-page__faq-list"><details><summary>What is an AI image generator?</summary><p>An AI image generator turns text prompts or reference images into original visuals. With MiniMax Design, you can describe what you want, add references, choose from leading AI models, and refine the result in one creative workflow.</p></details><details><summary>How do I generate AI images from text?</summary><p>Enter a simple description of the subject, setting, composition, lighting, and style you want. MiniMax Design transforms your prompt into high-quality images and lets you refine details, explore variations, or switch models without starting over.</p></details><details><summary>Can I generate AI images from a reference image?</summary><p>Yes. Upload a reference image to guide the subject, character, product, composition, colors, or visual style. MiniMax Design combines your reference with natural-language instructions, giving you more control and more consistent results.</p></details><details><summary>How do I write a good AI image prompt?</summary><p>Start with the subject and action, then add the setting, composition, lighting, camera angle, colors, mood, and visual style. Keep instructions clear and avoid conflicting details. References can help communicate a specific look more precisely.</p></details><details><summary>How do I keep characters consistent in AI images?</summary><p>Reuse the same character reference and repeat defining traits such as facial features, hairstyle, outfit, colors, and accessories. MiniMax Design helps preserve these details across poses, settings, and scenes, so recurring characters remain recognizable.</p></details><details><summary>How do I edit part of an AI-generated image?</summary><p>Describe exactly what you want to change and what must stay untouched. Use targeted AI editing to correct hands or faces, replace objects, adjust clothing, or refine the background while preserving the original composition and surrounding details. Explore the <a class="tool-page__heading-link" href="/tools/ai-photo-editor">AI Photo Editor</a> for background changes, object removal, and portrait editing.</p></details><details><summary>How do I improve AI image quality?</summary><p>Use a clear prompt, a high-quality reference, and a model suited to your intended style. Specify lighting, proportions, materials, textures, and important details, then refine selected areas or generate variations until the result matches your vision.</p></details><details><summary>Can I turn an AI-generated image into a video?</summary><p>Yes. Turn an AI-generated image or any still visual into a dynamic video with MiniMax Design. Add movement, facial expressions, camera motion, and scene direction, then continue refining the visuals and audio in the same creative workflow.</p></details><details><summary>Can I use AI-generated images commercially?</summary><p>Yes. You retain the rights to images you create with MiniMax Design and may use them commercially, subject to our Terms of Service. Do not create content that infringes others’ rights, causes harm, or defames anyone. All use must comply with our Acceptable Use Policy and the rules of the platforms where you publish.</p></details></div></div></section></main><footer class="footer"><div class="page-content-frame
